name: USB 手机浏览器调试
description: 通过 ADB 发现 Android 浏览器、转发端口、选择页面并使用 CDP 调试。

configure.description: Configure ADB executable and default device

browsers.description: Discover Chrome, Chromium and debugging-enabled WebView sockets

open.description: Create an owned dynamic ADB forward and list browser pages

parameters.socket: socket from browsers; optional when exactly one

connect.description: Connect page and enable Runtime/Debugger without resuming paused code

parameters.target_id: page id; optional when exactly one

cdp.description: Run existing chrome-devtools action: evaluate, screenshot, command, scripts, source_search, breakpoint_set, wait_for_pause, etc.

status.description: Read owned forward and debugger status

disconnect.description: Close debugger and remove only owned matching forward
